nisqa.name: nisqa
nisqa.description: Assess speech quality and get a Mean Opinion Score (MOS) using NISQA neural network. Use for evaluating synthesized speech, codec quality, or audio degradation.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to evaluate

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Prediction mode (default: predict_file)

outputs.name: mos
outputs.description: Mean Opinion Score (1.0-5.0 scale). Higher is better quality.

outputs.name: subscores
outputs.description: Detailed subscores: noisiness, discontinuity, coloration, loudness

speechmos.name: speechmos
speechmos.description: Predict Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for speech quality using Microsoft SpeechMOS model.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to evaluate

deepfake_audio.name: deepfake_audio
deepfake_audio.description: Detect if audio is real or AI-generated/deepfake. Use for authenticity verification, spoofing detection, and identifying synthetic speech.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to analyze for deepfake detection

outputs.name: is_deepfake
outputs.description: Boolean flag: true if audio is detected as fake/synthetic

audioseal.name: audioseal
audioseal.description: Detect and decode audio watermarks embedded by AudioSeal. Use for verifying AI-generated audio provenance.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to check for watermarks

silero_vad.name: silero_vad
silero_vad.description: Detect voice activity (speech segments) in audio using Silero VAD model. Returns timestamps of speech regions.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to analyze

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Speech detection threshold (0.0-1.0, default: 0.5)

inputs.name: min_speech_ms
inputs.description: Minimum speech segment duration in ms (default: 250)

inputs.name: min_silence_ms
inputs.description: Minimum silence gap to split segments in ms (default: 150)

outputs.name: speech_segments
outputs.description: List of detected speech segments: [{start: sec, end: sec}, ...]

outputs.name: total_speech_sec
outputs.description: Total duration of speech in seconds

outputs.name: speech_ratio
outputs.description: Ratio of speech to total audio duration (0.0-1.0)

language_id.name: language_id
language_id.description: Identify the spoken language in an audio file. Supports 107 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hindi.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to analyze

inputs.name: top_k
inputs.description: Number of top language predictions to return (default: 3)

outputs.name: detected_language
outputs.description: ISO language code of the detected language (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh')

outputs.name: detected_language_name
outputs.description: Full name of the detected language

outputs.name: confidence
outputs.description: Confidence score for the top prediction

outputs.name: top_predictions
outputs.description: List of top-k language predictions with scores

gender_detection.name: gender_detection
gender_detection.description: Detect the gender of speaker(s) in an audio file. Returns male/female classification with confidence scores.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to analyze

whisper.name: whisper
whisper.description: Transcribe speech to text using OpenAI Whisper model. Supports multiple languages and automatic language detection.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe

inputs.name: beam_size
inputs.description: Beam size for decoding (default: 5)

funasr.name: funasr
funasr.description: Transcribe speech using FunASR (Alibaba). Supports Chinese, English, and multilingual transcription with punctuation.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe

audio_caption.name: audio_caption
audio_caption.description: Generate natural language caption describing audio content using audio-language models.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to caption

outputs.name: caption
outputs.description: Natural language description of the audio content

sb_sgmse.name: sb_sgmse
sb_sgmse.description: Speech enhancement using SpeechBrain's SGMSE implementation. Diffusion-based enhancement.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the degraded audio file

outputs.name: enhanced_path
outputs.description: Path to the enhanced audio file

deepfilternet.name: deepfilternet
deepfilternet.description: Remove noise and enhance speech quality using DeepFilterNet neural network. Best for speech enhancement and noise suppression.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the noisy audio file

outputs.name: enhanced_audio_path
outputs.description: Path to the enhanced/denoised audio file

espnet_enhance.name: espnet_enhance
espnet_enhance.description: Enhance speech using ESPnet speech enhancement models. Supports various enhancement architectures.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the noisy audio file

outputs.name: enhanced_path
outputs.description: Path to the enhanced audio file

demucs.name: demucs
demucs.description: Separate audio into 4 stems: vocals, drums, bass, and other instruments using Meta's Demucs model.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to separate

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Model to use (default: htdemucs)

outputs.name: stems
outputs.description: Dictionary of separated audio paths: {vocals, drums, bass, other}

sepformer_wham.name: sepformer_wham
sepformer_wham.description: Separate noisy mixed speech using SepFormer trained on WHAM! dataset. Handles speech + noise.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the noisy mixed audio

diarizen.name: diarizen
diarizen.description: Perform speaker diarization - identify who spoke when in multi-speaker audio using Diarizen.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the multi-speaker audio file

outputs.name: segments
outputs.description: List of speaker segments: [{speaker: id, start: sec, end: sec}, ...]

resemblyzer.name: resemblyzer
resemblyzer.description: Extract speaker embeddings using Resemblyzer (d-vector). Use for speaker clustering and voice matching.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file

speaker_verification.name: speaker_verification
speaker_verification.description: Verify if two audio segments are from the same speaker, or extract speaker embeddings using ECAPA-TDNN.

inputs.name: audio_path_1
inputs.description: Path to the first audio file

inputs.name: audio_path_2
inputs.description: Path to the second audio file (for verification)

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: Task type: 'verify' (compare two audios) or 'embed' (extract embeddings)

outputs.name: same_speaker
outputs.description: Boolean: true if both audios are from the same speaker (verify mode)

outputs.name: embedding_dim
outputs.description: Dimension of speaker embedding (embed mode, typically 192)

clap_embed.name: clap_embed
clap_embed.description: Extract audio embeddings using CLAP (Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining). Useful for audio-text similarity.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file

r1_aqa.name: r1_aqa
r1_aqa.description: Answer questions about audio using R1-AQA audio question-answering model.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: Question to answer about the audio

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: Answer to the question about the audio

chromaprint.name: chromaprint
chromaprint.description: Generate acoustic fingerprint using Chromaprint/AcoustID. Use for audio identification and duplicate detection.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to fingerprint

desta25.name: desta25
desta25.description: Analyze audio content using DeSTA2.5-Audio-Llama model via OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to analyze

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Question or prompt for the audio analysis

wav2vec2_quality.name: wav2vec2_quality
wav2vec2_quality.description: Reference-free audio quality assessment using Wav2Vec2 embeddings. Analyzes energy variance in latent feature space to detect synthesis artifacts.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to evaluate

outputs.name: quality_score
outputs.description: Quality score (0-1 scale, higher is better)

outputs.name: metrics
outputs.description: Detailed quality metrics including stability and consistency

audioldm_eval.name: audioldm_eval
audioldm_eval.description: Detect generative artifacts using AudioLDM evaluation metrics. Computes Frechet Audio Distance (FAD), KL-Divergence, and CLAP similarity.

inputs.name: audio_path
inputs.description: Path to the audio file to evaluate

outputs.name: fad_score
outputs.description: Frechet Audio Distance - lower is more natural

outputs.name: metrics
outputs.description: All evaluation metrics including FAD, KL, CLAP similarity
